content: मद् A form of the first personal pronoun in the singular number used chiefly at the beginning of <ab>comps.</ab>; as मदर्थे ‘for me’, ‘for my sake’; मच्चित्त ‘thinking of me’; मद्वचनम्, मत्संदेशः, मत्प्रियम् <ab>&c.</ab> <ab>&c.</ab>; मन्मना भव मद्भक्तो मद्याजी मां नमस्कुरु <ls>Bg. 18. 65</ls>.

मद् I. €4 <ab>P.</ab> (माद्यति, मत्त) .²1 To be drunk or intoxicated; वीक्ष्य मद्यमितरा तु ममाद <ls>Śi. 10. 27</ls>. .²2 To be mad. .²3 To revel or delight in. .²4 To be glad or rejoiced. .²5 <ab>Ved.</ab> To satisfy, delight, gladden. .²6 To enjoy supreme felicity. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} (मादयति) .²1 To intoxicate; inebriate, madden. .²2 (मदयति) To exhilarate, gladden, delight; मायूरी मदयति मार्जना मनांसि <ls>M. 1. 21</ls>; प्रकृतिमधुराः सन्त्येवान्ये मनो मदयन्ति ये <ls>Māl. 1. 36</ls>; <ls>Śi. 13. 38</ls>; <ls>Ki. 5. 26</ls>. .²3 To inflame with passion; मदयति हृदयम् <ls>Māl. 3. 6</ls>. .²4 (<ab>Ātm.</ab>) To be glad, rejoice, be pleased. --II. €10 <ab>Ā.</ab> (मादयते) To please, gratify. --III. €1 <ab>P.</ab> (मदति) .²1 To be proud. .²2 To be poor.
